Recorded claim:
D211271 kept an unimplemented verifyAttachment path and explicitly deferred the async caller cleanup. The 2024 RNP method threw; current RNP code reads the attachment and signature files and returns whether verifyDetached succeeds, added in Bug 1953126. Review or implementation work must inspect the current method before citing the 2024 stub as a present limitation. No runtime test was run in this history study.

Provenance: c5f12ccd0a8709db42f2c7fb0fc7ec779d6c627dcd5092b7230e514460d81037. Original evidence IDs: 45f4be4595ae286636e4d14d05fab2bdc7e49df917d2f20d5cb712ac3d4db11b, a755cd06e5d5b62467d44a088cfbe877f1a507e285d20c5e32505438fde8cfc6, eb776053dfdd2ee6c6e015620de52677d1c62b56afdcee7b0d8e7147a997cb6f.
